This release, together with changes on the server, fixes the slow and stuck sign-ins after the app has been idle.

## Fixes in the app

- The show-password button works while a sign-in is in progress. The form fields used to be fully disabled during the request, and a disabled field in Flutter ignores taps on its icons too. The fields are now read-only instead.
- Signing in is retried automatically if the server is still starting, so you no longer need to press the button again.

## Fixes on the server

- The API no longer goes to sleep. A Netlify scheduled function pings it every 5 minutes, with a GitHub Actions job as a backup.
- The health check no longer queries the database. It used to run on every platform probe, which would have kept the Neon database awake all month and used up its free compute hours.
- Database connections are opened fresh for each request, as Django recommends for apps served over ASGI. Requests no longer hang on a connection the database dropped while it was idle.

## Download

Install `TaskForge-1.0.2-arm64-v8a.apk` on most phones, or `TaskForge-1.0.2-universal.apk` if you are not sure. It installs over earlier versions and keeps you signed in.

Demo account: `admin@taskforge.dev` with the password `TaskForge2024!`.
